meta.title: Model image input
meta.description: Adds a per-model "supports images" checkbox to every third-party provider card on the Models settings page (the llm-pi-ai adapter family: OpenAI-compatible gateways and self-hosted endpoints). The checkbox reflects the model's effective input modalities with the same precedence the pi-ai adapter resolves (entry input, then the installed catalog, then the route's defaultInput). Checking it writes input ["text","image"] so image attachments are sent to that model; unchecking writes ["text"]. Reads and writes go through the official settings service with revision conflict detection, and the official Models editor keeps working beside it. No restart is needed.
